scope: Direct complete-original-body prerequisite research of the final five Sickn33 originals. All 1076 original lines were read as inert data. No market query, installation, deployment, relayer, site-health or transcript-service operation was executed.
linked_reference_caveat: Only original bodies were reviewed. Underlying implementations, referenced guides, actual service schemas, licensed public artifacts and runtime eligibility require separate review. Source metadata, examples, risk labels, quotas and version claims do not establish independent validation or study outcomes.

sources.workflow: Bind an actual market request to exact venue, instrument and observation times, interpret available indicator and derivatives fields without inventing missing values and distinguish historical description from prediction or trade execution.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual reviewed tool schemas and implementation, authorized public retained market observations, exact indicator windows and instrument multipliers, relevant detailed guides and independent arithmetic and missing-data checks are required. Full integration needs authorized isolated provider access and quota; the guide alone supplies no live data.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual indicator parser, timeframe aggregator, confluence or funding-unit defect can be offline using genuine public retained responses and stubbed transport. It cannot establish current market conditions, a forecast or investment performance. No account, provider, position, order or market endpoint was accessed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify timestamp and closed-candle status, venue and multiplier, actual requested versus fixed summary settings, insufficient-data propagation, exact timeframe coverage and funding interval arithmetic. Tool notes and OI-price quadrant names are not independently validated participant intent or liquidation causes. A score threshold or aligned subset must not silently imply confidence across missing timeframes.

sources.workflow: Validate an actual project build and environment separation, publish only to the exact authorized sandbox target and verify resulting readiness and deployment identity before any separately authorized production transition.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual public application and reviewed build and deployment workflow, compatible pinned Node and CLI dependencies, independent application acceptance checks and an authorized isolated service project are required. The docs-only entry supplies no deployment tools, private credentials or production authorization; runtime and quota limits need exact current version evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual configuration parser, rewrite builder, workflow-output or geolocation fallback defect can be offline on genuine public project artifacts and stubbed deployment responses. It cannot prove a real deployment, secret scope, preview accessibility or functioning edge runtime. No CLI, install, login, environment pull, project, domain, deploy, promote or rollback operation occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact project, branch, revision and environment, trustworthy preview-output parsing, correct target runtime, real build and behavior results and no credential exposure to untrusted fork code. Geolocation from trusted ingress is approximate routing information, not authentication; a successful process or preview link does not establish protected production behavior or safe promotion.

sources.workflow: Represent actual approved chain-specific relayer-register requirements in consistent exact-amount artifacts while separating descriptive balances and health fields from real signing, nonce locking, sponsorship and replenishment enforcement.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual public schema or relayer implementation and task, exact chain, network, address and base-unit contracts, genuine public artifacts and independent amount and state-invariant verifiers are required. Live transaction operations need isolated authorized resources and funding, which are neither supplied nor authorized by this source.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual schema mapping, decimal conversion, enum or register-validation defect can be offline using genuine public code and artifacts. It does not establish atomic relayer behavior or on-chain balances. No key, chain endpoint, transaction, reserve, funding, rebalance or relayer node was accessed or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact integer base units or validated decimal strings, network-specific address and fee rules, nonnegative bounds and consistent schema relations. The mixed-chain field table requires chain-specific refinement before freezing a task. A register row, risk-safe label or health timestamp cannot prove sponsorship authorization, atomic nonce reservation, transaction reconciliation or available funds.

sources.workflow: Parse an actual version-bound site-health report, retain exact producer titles and passed states, map only supported findings to scoped remediation and verify restore, staged configuration and application behavior before crediting a fix.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real authorized public report and exact WordPress and plugin versions, reviewed referenced catalog and actual remediation implementation, independent checks of configuration semantics and separately authorized isolated server resources are required. A report does not supply current PHP values, a cache backend or a supported universal health command.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual report classifier, config transformer, duplicate-constant handler or upload-unit defect can be offline using genuine public artifacts and inert server responses. Full remediation requires its real reviewed platform. No site, database, backup, plugin, indexing, firewall, cache or server configuration was read or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify producer-specific item identity, no changes to passed or unmatched findings, exact supported directive scope, unique constant edits, preservation of existing cache drop-ins and private backup and restore validity. Check staged syntax and real sandbox readiness; existence of a cache file, later PHP lint or a claimed parent backup path does not prove effective safe configuration, isolation or recovery.

sources.workflow: For an actually authorized caption or discovery request, validate exact query and destination, preserve returned transcript and pagination identity and expose unavailable, rate-limited and paid states without inventing timestamps or retrying purchases.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual reviewed provider adapter and current schema and terms, authorized retained public transcript and response artifacts, independent parameter, pagination and output checks and separate sandbox credential access for real integration are required. Public availability does not by itself grant republication rights; signup and personal contact transfer are not study prerequisites to invent.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual request validator, opaque continuation handler, transcript extractor or error-state defect can be offline using genuine authorized public retained responses with stubbed transport. It does not fetch current captions, create an account or establish service allowance. No signup, contact transfer, key handling, service call, download or media publication occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact video and language identity, endpoint and query validation, encoded arguments, no credential forwarding across redirects, continuation preservation and termination and explicit HTTP error and partial-coverage states. The single-string transcript endpoint supplies no per-line timestamps; sample code and source assertions do not establish a successful call, complete channel inventory or permission to retain all returned content.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
